answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 4252 Country: India Title: I want to know the namaaz n duaa, on first night of wedding, bfore intercourse with wife first night. Question: I want to know the namaaz n duaa, on first night of wedding, bfore intercourse with wife first night. Answer ID: 4252 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 299/299=M/1429) On first night of wedding, you should recite this dua while holding hair of your wife's forehead: الهم اني اسأ لك من خيرها و خير ما جب ل تها عليه و أعوذ بك من شرها و شر ما جبلتها عليه Afterwards, you should perform two rakah salah of thanks with husband standing forth and wife behind him. After the salah, you should do dua for goodness and blessings, mutual love and harmony. When you intend to have intercourse with your wife, you should recite this dua : اللهم جنبنا الشيطان و جنب الشيطان ما رزقتنا Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
